children.title: Operational Criteria for Publicly Reliable Physical Records

detail.title: Operational Criteria for Publicly Reliable Physical Records
detail.question: What are the necessary operational conditions for a quantum state to qualify as a stable, publicly accessible objective record?
detail.reason: This project aligns with the selected attention topic and addresses the gap between theoretical redundancy and reliable public accessibility.

children.title: Robustness of Physical Records Across Independent Observers

detail.title: Robustness of Physical Records Across Independent Observers
detail.question: What makes a record robust across independent observers?
detail.reason: The topic requires establishing a clear definition of observer agreement before analyzing counterexamples to redundancy-based objectivity.
